newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates rise on fund shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates rise on fund shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates ended higher on Friday amid a fund shortage, and dealers said the demand from borrowers was likely to keep the rates up on Saturday.

"Tighter conditions prevailed today and the overnight trades started at around 19.90 percent," a dealer said. "Some borrowers managed to get funds at 19.50 percent, but the rates bounced back to 20 percent towards the close as the market remained short of funds."
The market closed short and banks had to approach the central bank discount window for moderate amounts, dealers said.
They said one-week lenders managed to place nominal amounts around 19 percent, while term repos remained quiet and no change was seen in the rates.
